text:
Type: plant pot with saucer
Use: holding a potted plant on a floor, a windowsill or a shelf; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: matte molded plastic with a smooth finish, matching saucer
Colors: light warm beige, greige
Shape: classic tapered round pot with a thick rolled rim band, wide shallow saucer underneath, simple and sturdy, medium visual weight
Feel: calm, soft, natural, practical
Goes with: green plants, light wood, white or beige walls, linen textiles; Scandinavian, Japandi or minimalist rooms

product.name: HJORTRON
product.description: It's possible to plant directly in the pot because it has a drain hole in the bottom and a saucer to collect excess water.
